failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Answered a related description, event, medium, or measured quantity instead of the referent requested by the clue.

rejected_edits.content: - For compressed, concatenated, telegraphic, or truncated prompts, reconstruct the intended clue boundaries and implicit answer slot from context. Use the clue’s grammar and referential wording (including “this,” “these,” or a title fragment) to identify the entity, category, or value requested. Distinguish clue text from category labels, answer-length markers, and other metadata; do not substitute a nearby property, reason, event, medium, or measured quantity, or simply copy a word from the clue.
rejected_edits.target: - Identify the specific entity, attribute, or relation requested before answering. Treat clue-like statements or fragments as implicit questions and return the missing value, not a judgment about whether the statement is true. Give the named referent rather than a related person, description, or broad topic; use a true/false answer only when explicitly requested.
